about.label: ServiceNow
about.summary: American software company that supplies cloud computing platforms for the creation and management of automated business workflows.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, jejíž cloudová platforma automatizuje firemní procesy, třeba IT podporu nebo personalistiku.

about.label: Applied Materials
about.summary: American corporation that supplies equipment, services and software for the manufacture of semiconductor chips for electronics, flat panel displays for computers, smartphones, televisions, and solar products.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která dodává zařízení, služby a software pro výrobu čipů, displejů a solárních panelů.

about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: The Travelers Companies
about.summary: American multinational insurance company.
about.summary_cs: Americká pojišťovna, která nabízí hlavně pojištění majetku a odpovědnosti firmám i domácnostem.

about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.label: Welltower
about.summary: Real estate investment trust that invests in healthcare infrastructure.
about.summary_cs: Americký realitní fond (REIT), který vlastní bydlení pro seniory a zdravotnické budovy.

about.label: Merck KGaA
about.summary: German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, with about 60,000 employees and a presence in 66 countries. Merck was founded in 1668 and is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company, as well as one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally.
about.summary_cs: Německá vědecko-technologická firma, která vyrábí léky, laboratorní potřeby a materiály pro elektroniku.

about.label: Verizon
about.summary:
American telecommunications company headquartered in New York City. The company was founded as Bell Atlantic Corporation and renamed to Verizon on June 30, 2000 as a result of a merger with GTE.
Bell Atlantic was originally headquartered in Philadelphia and operated in the states of Pennsylvania, New Jersey, Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, and West Virginia.
about.summary_cs: Americký telekomunikační operátor, největší mobilní operátor v USA.

about.label: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was one of the first biotech firms to use an explicit strategy of rational drug design rather than combinatorial chemistry.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na cystickou fibrózu a další vážná onemocnění.

about.label: Motorola Solutions
about.summary: American technology company that provides safety and security products and services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí radiostanice, kamerové systémy a software pro policii, hasiče a záchranáře.

holdings.name: BANK OF NEW YORK MELLON CORP

about.label: The Bank of New York Mellon
about.summary: American international financial services company headquartered in New York City.
about.summary_cs: Americká banka, největší správce a úschovce cenných papírů na světě.

about.label: McKesson Corporation
about.summary: American publicly traded company that distributes pharmaceuticals and provides health information technology, medical supplies, and health management tools.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, největší distributor léků v USA, která dodává i zdravotnický materiál a software.

about.label: Williams Companies
about.summary: American energy company based in Tulsa, Oklahoma. Its core business is natural gas processing and transportation, with additional petroleum and electricity generation assets.
about.summary_cs: Americká energetická firma, která zpracovává a přepravuje zemní plyn, hlavně plynovody.

about.label: Cisco
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. Cisco specializes in specific tech markets, such as the Internet of things, domain security, videoconferencing, and ener
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí síťová zařízení, například routery a switche, a software pro sítě a bezpečnost.

about.label: The Coca-Cola Company
about.summary: American multinational corporation founded in January 1892, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia. It manufactures, sells and markets soft drinks including Coca-Cola, other non-alcoholic beverage concentrates and syrups, and alcoholic beverages.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce nápojů, mimo jiné Coca-Coly, Sprite a Fanty.

about.label: Texas Instruments
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The company's focus is on developing analog chips and embedded processors, which account for more than 80% of its revenue.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce analogových čipů a procesorů pro průmysl a auta.

about.label: Mastercard
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in Purchase, New York.
industry: financial service activities, except insurance and pension funding
industry_cs: finanční služby, kromě pojišťovnictví a penzijního financování
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Mastercard.

about.label: Gilead Sciences
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, that focuses on researching and developing antiviral drugs used in the treatment of HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, influenza, and COVID-19. It also develops medicines in therapeutic areas such as oncology and inflammation and cell therapy.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na HIV, žloutenku a rakovinu.

about.label: Visa Inc.
about.summary: American multinational payment card services corporation headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která provozuje platební síť Visa, největší na světě.

about.label: AT&T
about.summary: American multinational telecommunications company headquartered at the Whitacre Tower in Downtown Dallas, Texas. AT&T is the world's third-largest telecommunications company by revenue, the third-largest wireless carrier in the United States behind T-Mobile and Verizon, and the nation's largest fiber internet provider.
about.summary_cs: Americký telekomunikační operátor, který nabízí mobilní služby a internet.

about.label: Cencora
about.summary: American drug wholesale and distribution company and a contract research organization, that was formed by the merger of Bergen Brunswig and AmeriSource in 2001.
about.summary_cs: Americký velkoobchod a distributor léků, který provádí i klinický výzkum na zakázku.

about.label: Chubb Corp.
about.summary: American–Swiss company incorporated in Zürich and listed on the New York Stock Exchange, where it is a component of the S&P 500. Chubb is a global provider of insurance products covering property and casualty, accident and health, reinsurance, and life insurance, and is the largest publicly traded property and casualty insurance company in the world.
about.summary_cs: Švýcarsko-americká pojišťovna, největší veřejně obchodovaná majetková pojišťovna na světě, která nabízí i úrazové, zdravotní a životní pojištění.

about.label: Automatic Data Processing
about.summary: American multinational provider of cloud-based human resources management, payroll processing, and professional employer organization services, headquartered in Roseland, New Jersey.
about.summary_cs: Americký poskytovatel cloudových služeb pro personalistiku a zpracování mezd.

about.label: GE Vernova
about.summary: Energy equipment manufacturing and services company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí plynové a větrné turbíny a zařízení pro rozvodné sítě; vznikla oddělením od General Electric.

about.label: Adobe
about.summary: American multinational computer software company based in San Jose, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, autor Photoshopu, Acrobatu a dalších nástrojů pro tvorbu a úpravu obsahu.

about.label: Progressive Corporation
about.summary: American insurance company headquartered in Mayfield, Ohio.
about.summary_cs: Americká pojišťovna, jeden z největších pojistitelů aut v USA.

about.label: Colgate-Palmolive Company
about.summary: American multinational consumer products company headquartered on Park Avenue in Midtown Manhattan, New York City.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce zubních past, mýdel a krmiva pro zvířata, mimo jiné značek Colgate a Palmolive.

about.label: Cardinal Health
about.summary: American multinational health care services company, and the 15th highest revenue generating company in the United States.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která distribuuje léky a zdravotnický materiál.

about.label: Marvell Technology
about.summary: American company, headquartered in Santa Clara, California, which develops and produces semiconductors and related technology.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje čipy pro datová centra, sítě a ukládání dat.

about.label: Johnson & Johnson
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical technologies corporation headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí léky a zdravotnické prostředky.

about.label: Procter & Gamble
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce drogerie a hygienických potřeb se značkami jako Pampers, Gillette, Ariel a Head & Shoulders.

about.label: Amphenol
about.summary: One of the largest designers, manufacturers and marketers of electrical, electronic and fiber optic connectors and interconnect systems, antennas, sensors and sensor-based products and coaxial, high-speed, fiber optic, and specialty cable.
about.summary_cs: Jeden z největších výrobců elektrických a optických konektorů, antén, senzorů a speciálních kabelů.

about.label: T-Mobile US
about.summary: American wireless network operator headquartered in Bellevue, Washington.
about.summary_cs: Americký mobilní operátor, jeden ze tří největších v USA.

about.label: CME Group
about.summary: CME Group Inc., headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, operates exchanges and provides clearing services for trading in financial derivatives such as futures contracts, options, and swaps. The company operates the Globex Trading System, an electronic trading platform that allows customers in approximately 150 countries to trade futures and options contracts.
about.summary_cs: Americký provozovatel burz, na kterých se obchodují futures, opce a swapy, a poskytovatel zúčtovacích služeb.

about.label: Salesforce
about.summary: American enterprise software company headquartered in San Francisco, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká softwarová firma, největší dodavatel cloudového softwaru pro řízení vztahů se zákazníky (CRM).

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Kinder Morgan
about.summary: American energy infrastructure company. It specializes in owning and controlling oil and gas pipelines and terminals.
about.summary_cs: Americká energetická firma, která vlastní a provozuje plynovody, ropovody a terminály.

about.label: The Home Depot
about.summary: American multinational home improvement retail corporation which sells tools, construction products, appliances, and services including fuel and transportation rentals.
about.summary_cs: Americký řetězec obchodů pro kutily a stavebniny, největší na světě.
